summary: Restoration pledges include 14,500 ha in the West Bank and 800 ha in Gaza for terrestrial ecosystems and 400 ha of afforestation/reforestation—about 1.0% of the 411 km² forest cover. One passage identifies a potential 200 ha/year over five years, while passages report well and spring rehabilitation at 100% by 2030 and 95%. Conservation targets 320 km² under protected management in the West Bank (5.2% of national land area), 3,000 ha of coastal/marine management, and 70% treated-wastewater reuse by 2030. Agriculture commits 50% of farms to gender-sensitive climate-smart farming by 2040 and 35,000 ha in the West Bank plus 6,500 ha in Gaza under resilient practices, together equivalent to 14.4% of the 2,883 km² agricultural area. Mixed pledges cover 15,500 ha in the West Bank and 4,500 ha in Gaza restored or managed, plus a 2% annual increase in rehabilitated or managed green areas through 2040.
